title: PM Studio
tagline: A local workspace that walks a product from discovery to launch, with Claude doing the drafting and critiquing at every stage.
description: PM Studio is a browser front end for PM Tools, my set of 12 Claude skills for product management (strategy, PRD, prioritization, roadmap, prototype, launch, metrics and more). It lays out the product lifecycle as stages, from Discover to Learn, each with an entry gate and a done-when check, and it reads progress from a stage tracker in plain Markdown files. Buttons run Claude Code in the product folder: draft a document, score it against a rubric, run a panel of six reviewer personas, or apply the top fixes. Every output is a Markdown file, so the same work can continue in Claude Code at any time. When a stage is ready, PM Studio writes short stakeholder pages and publishes them to Confluence, and turns the PRD's user stories into Jira stories without touching tickets the team has already started. I use it to run my own HR-assistant product from research to usability testing.
